## Goal

An opt-in, paced evaluation suite that measures whether agents succeed with Mostra on the first try and keep succeeding across turns.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| AX-08 | An opt-in, budgeted agent-evaluation suite measures first-pass verify success, turns to pass and retention across turns (subject to D33 confirmation) | E | Evaluation harness pilot report with provider, model, date and tokens; batches announced (D34, D64) |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- an opt-in, paced evaluation harness (D34, D64) that grows from the C03-A harness: scenarios over templates and journeys (one-off and long-lived, team, hosted and relay), first-pass `verify` success, turns to pass, and retention across turns;
- per-run recording of provider, model, date and tokens;
- small-batch pacing;
- reports.

Design detail for this package:

- Grow the EVAL-01 harness onto the real toolchain: scenarios over templates and journeys J1 to J12 and the team, hosted and relay journeys (J13, J14), first-pass verify, turns to pass, retention across turns.
- Pacing per D64, announcements per D34, records per STANDARDS.
- Re-run the base comparison on Mostra's own kit.

## Out of scope

- Prose quality (never measured by evaluations)

## Acceptance evidence

a pilot batch (announced to Mirza, GPT-only first) produces a report; the harness reproduces EVAL-01's base comparison; runs with Claude models only after Mirza approves them.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Model mix variety (D34): don't optimize for one model.
